newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks down 1.2 million barrels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks down 1.2 million barrels.

text.p: U.S. propane inventories fell by 1.2 million barrels in the week ending February 28, a draw that had been moderated by warm temperatures, the Energy Information Administration report showed Wednesday.
U.S. inventories, currently at 24.3 million barrels, remain slightly below the normal range for this time of year but 2.6 million barrels above year-ago levels.
Regionally, inventories were mixed. The key Gulf Coast hub was down 1.2 million barrels and the Midwest, a large home heating fuel market, was up 100,000 barrels, the EIA report showed.
Traders said the draw largely reflected petrochemical demand, which although still large, has tapered off in the past two weeks.
The East Coast was down 100,000 barrels. ((--Laney Salisbury, 1212 859-1631))
